en.headline: Education Bureau approves five schools for five S1 classes in 2027 allocation
en.dek: The approved schools are Fanling Rhenish Church Secondary School, HKTA Tang Hin Memorial Secondary School, Munsang College (Hong Kong Island), St Mark's School and Tin Ka Ping Secondary School.
body: The Education Bureau announced on Wednesday that five schools have been approved to participate in the 2027 Secondary One allocation with five classes, under a pilot scheme that allows eligible schools currently operating four classes to expand.

The schools are Fanling Rhenish Church Secondary School, Hong Kong Taoist Association Tang Hin Memorial Secondary School, Munsang College (Hong Kong Island), St Mark's School and Tin Ka Ping Secondary School. Fifteen schools that currently operate four Secondary One classes had applied.

Approval considered factors including school facilities, track record, parental preference, overall place supply and demand, and local district conditions. Under the scheme, schools must have received self-allocated place applications equalling at least 100 per cent of available places in each of the past three years, and have suitable premises.
The bureau said it would continue to review the arrangements to adjust resources dynamically while addressing changes in the school-age population and aiming for a soft landing.

zh.headline: 教育局批准五間中學以五班參加2027年度中一派位
zh.dek: 獲批學校包括粉嶺禮賢會中學、香港道教聯合會鄧顯紀念中學、港島民生書院、聖馬可中學及田家炳中學。
body: 教育局今日公布，經審視後批准五間中學以五班參加2027年度的中一派位。這些學校目前以四班中一參加派位，符合先導計劃條件後獲准擴班。
獲批學校為粉嶺禮賢會中學、香港道教聯合會鄧顯紀念中學、港島民生書院、聖馬可中學及田家炳中學。今年度共有15間以四班中一的學校申請以五班參加派位。
當局審視因素包括學校配套設施、辦學往績、家長意願、整體學額供求情況及學校所在地區的實際情況。先導計劃規定，學校須在最近連續三個年度的中一派位中，每年度收到的自行分配學位申請數目不少於可供派位學位數目的100%，且校舍條件配合。
教育局表示會持續檢視有關安排，動態調整教育資源，應對學齡人口變化帶來的挑戰，達至軟著陸目標。
